column4: A corner occupying a vanishing fraction of the matrix can therefore carry the entire obstruction, which is why the corner below is renormalized by its own rank. Rhetorical motivation for lem:central-corona-corner's per-corner renormalization convention; asserts no mathematical content of its own beyond what the lemma itself states and proves. No decl needed, matching precedent for similar transition sentences in this census (e.g. 186ab929187a, ea89f566cf20). New row (2026-09-09), lane s-sec2b.

Already-landed, previously uncensused carriers: cornerEmbedSeq_cornerCompressSeq_apply is literally "the printed representative" (compressing and re-embedding a sequence gives (q_nz_nq_n)); norm_mk_cornerEmbedSeq is literally "the printed identification of the corner with the corona" (the class of (J_nc_nJ_n*) has the same norm as the class of (c_n), i.e. the identification is injective/isometric); cornerEmbedSeq_mul/_star/_one_apply supply the *-algebra-map half (J_n additive/multiplicative/adjoint-preserving/unit-preserving). The module's own docstring quotes this exact printed sentence and states "That sentence is the one piece of the rewritten proof the development did not carry" -- i.e. this file exists precisely to carry it, at full printed generality, unconditionally. New row (2026-09-09), lane s-sec2b; no new Lean needed, existing declaration reused per rule 7/13.

thm:normal-kazhdan proof: "Fix a free ultrafilter omega and let tau be the limit along omega of the normalized traces of the coordinates M_{r_n}(C). A norm-null sequence has vanishing traces, since |tr_{r_n}(x)|<=||x||, so tau is a well defined tracial state on Q_r." No prior Lean anywhere in the tree literally constructed this tau: NormalKazhdanSentences.lean carries the OLDER printed proof (Kazhdan inequality b>=(kappa^2/|S|)1), and NormalKazhdanPrintedRoute.lean deliberately bypasses this exact ultrafilter/tau construction with a different limsup-based finitary route (its own docstring: "the manuscript's proof was rewritten to avoid ultrafilters" -- but the printed tex on disk still literally contains this sentence, so it is in scope). New module GroupApproximation/Manuscript/NonMFSentences/CompressionSentencesB.lean closes it directly: tau := TracialUltraproduct.seqUltratrace (Analysis/TracialMatrixUltraproduct.lean's ultrafilter-limit normalized trace, reused unmodified for its representative-level linearity/unit/traciality/positivity, none of which is quotient-specific); manuscriptSentence_ultrafilterNormalizedTraceWellDefined supplies the one genuinely new piece, well-definedness against the printed operator-norm corona NormMatrixCStarCorona (Q_r) from |tr_{r_n}(x)|<=||x|| (PrintedPreliminaryEstimates.norm_normTrace_le_l2_opNorm), which TracialMatrixUltraproduct.lean's own ultratrace never needed (it targets the Hilbert-Schmidt-null quotient instead). Landed 2026-09-09 as commit 3a3f87e16 after a green remote probe (2739 jobs). Lane s-sec2b.
